Springwood_to_Local_School_5.2km.name: Springwood to Rochedale South State School (5.2km)

pre_covid_2014_2019.description: Stable car dominance (ABS 2016: 95.2% vehicle access). Low frequency suburban bus cannot compete with 8.5min drive.

covid_trough_2020_2022.description: Massive transit avoidance; private car served as essential isolation cocoon.

recovery_and_inflation_2022_2024.description: High fuel costs raised NPF sensitivity; slight modal shift to bus and cycling.

fifty_cent_era_2024_2026.description: First time breaking 7M trips. However, local school commute remains 70% car-locked due to 2.2km first-mile deficit.

Springwood_to_UQ_St_Lucia_28.8km.name: Springwood to UQ St Lucia Campus (28.8km)
Springwood_to_UQ_St_Lucia_28.8km.network_link: Route 555 Express Busway to Buranda -> Route 66 / Brisbane Metro M2 via Eleanor Schonell Bridge

pre_covid_2014_2019.description: Eleanor Schonell Bridge prohibited private cars, granting dedicated right-of-way.

covid_trough_2020_2022.description: Campus closure and hybrid lectures reduced university transit travel.

recovery_and_inflation_2022_2024.description: Rent and living cost spike elevated student NPF; transit surged above 60%.

fifty_cent_era_2024_2026.route_66_volume: Upgraded to Brisbane Metro M2: 2.3M trips in first 6 months, +60% overall surge
fifty_cent_era_2024_2026.description: 50c fare + 24-metre bi-articulated Metro M2 electric fleet unlocked historic high transit capture (68.8%).
